purpose: Separate internal calligraphy research eligibility from Daylight Cafe public exhibition eligibility.

researchCorpus.description: Internal evidence layer for Teacher Memory, Hand Grammar, character retrieval, component study, phrase-flow study, copies/tracings/rubbings and reconstruction research.

daylightCafe.description: Public-facing calligraphy-post exhibition in Daylight Cafe. This is a curated publication surface, not a mirror of the Research Corpus.
daylightCafe.queryRule: Only records with publicDisplayAllowed=true may be returned to Daylight Cafe exhibition queries.
daylightCafe.wholeWorkRule: A work with wholeWorkPublicDisplayAllowed=false must never appear as a complete displayed calligraphy resource, even when internal research evidence derived from it is retained.
excludedWholeWorkCategories: 佛教經典或寺院語境作品 explicitly marked non-public by project policy

policyExamples.publicationNote: May contribute internal evidence but must not be surfaced as a Daylight Cafe exhibition resource.

evidenceInheritance.rule: Derived research observations inherit source provenance and publication restriction metadata.
evidenceInheritance.historicalGlyphEvidence: A glyph or structural observation from a non-public work may inform Teacher Memory and Project Hand internally. It does not make the source work eligible for public exhibition.
evidenceInheritance.generatedProjectOutput: Future original Project Hand output is evaluated under its own publication policy and does not automatically inherit whole-work exhibition status from every research source used to learn grammar.

gateOrder: Teacher Memory / Hand Grammar evidence processing
hardRules: Research exclusion and publication exclusion are different decisions.
Never discard useful internal evidence merely because the complete source work is excluded from Daylight Cafe.
Never expose a restricted complete work through Daylight Cafe merely because individual evidence records are research-eligible.
Do not download whole works by default; use remote-resource adapters and existing transcoding infrastructure when visual access is required.
All derived evidence remains traceable to its source and restriction state.

tc001Correction.previousTreatment: hits excluded from coverage because the work was treated as globally prohibited
tc001Correction.correctedTreatment: restore hits such as 端、智、慧、是 as research candidates with restricted-publication provenance; verify each candidate before promoting its TC001 evidence state

nextGate.name: restricted-research-evidence-pass
nextGate.requirement: Verify TC001 candidates from research-allowed/public-hidden sources and bind them to Teacher Memory without making those works visible in Daylight Cafe.
